title: 30 MINUTES OPEN HEAVEN MORNING PRAYER THAT OPENS THE FLOODS GATE OF HEAVEN
text: Somewhere right now in this city, in another city, in another country, someone is sitting in a car in a parking lot. They have arrived at work, but they cannot bring themselves to walk inside. Their hands are gripping the steering wheel, their stomach is in knots, their heart is racing because inside that building is a boss who does not like them, a supervisor who overlooks them, a manager who criticizes everything they do, a team leader who has made their work life a living nightmare, and they are asking themselves, "Should I even go in today? Should I just resign? Is there any point continuing in a place where I am invisible, unappreciated, and unfavored?" If that is you, if you are that person in the parking lot, on the bus, on the train, walking toward an office where you feel unwelcomed, the Holy Ghost told me to tell you do not quit, not yet, not today, because something is about to change. Not your job, not your boss, not your department, your atmosphere. The spiritual atmosphere around you is about to shift so dramatically that the same boss who ignored you yesterday will notice you today. The same supervisor who passed you over last month will call your name this month. The same manager who criticized your every move will commend your next move. Not because they suddenly became nice, because God touched their heart. Because the prayer you are about to pray is going to reach into the chest cavity of your boss and turn their heart toward you like a river of water. That is what we are doing this morning. We are not changing jobs, we are changing atmospheres, we are not replacing bosses. We are reprogramming them, we are not running from workplaces, we are transforming them from the inside out by the power of the Holy Ghost. Now, quickly share this. Do not wait. Someone you know is dreading walking into work today. Someone on your contact list is thinking about quitting because their boss has made their life impossible. Someone in your circle is crying in a bathroom stall at the office because they feel invisible. This prayer is their lifeline. Share it now. God might use your one tap of the share button to prevent someone from making a decision they will regret. Share it. Now lift your hands. I want to worship but not from a place of strength this time. I want to worship from a place of vulnerability. The place where you feel small, the place where you feel powerless. The place where you feel like an employee who has no control over how their boss perceives them. That is the most honest place to worship from because worship is not about pretending you have it together. Worship is about admitting you do not have it together and declaring that God does. Sing with me. You are my strength when I am weak. You are the treasure that I seek. You are my all in all. Seeking you as a precious jewel. Lord, to give up I would be a fool. You are my all in all. Jesus, Lamb of God, worthy is your name. Jesus, Lamb of God, worthy is your name. Again, let the words minister to the place in your spirit that has been bruised by workplace rejection. Let the melody soothe the wound that was inflicted by a harsh word from a superior. Let the harmony heal the scar left by being overlooked for promotion while someone less qualified was chosen. You are my strength when I am weak. You are the treasure that I seek. You are my all in all. Taking my sin, my cross, my shame. Rising again, I bless your name. You are my all in all. Jesus, Lamb of God, worthy is your name. Jesus, Lamb of God, worthy is your name. Father, we worship you. We worship you as the God who gives favor. The God who turned the heart of Pharaoh's warden toward Joseph in prison. Genesis chapter 39 verse 21. The God who turned the heart of King Artaxerxes toward Nehemiah. Nehemiah chapter 2. The God who turned the heart of King Ahasuerus toward Esther. Esther chapter 5. You are the master of hearts. Every heart is in your hand. Every mind bows to your influence. Every attitude submits to your adjustment. And we worship you because we know that the heart of our boss, however hardened, however resistant, however hostile, is put in your hands. Let worship shift now. Let it rise. You are good. You are good. Oh, oh, oh. You are good. You are good. Oh, oh, oh. All you do is good. Good. Good. The Lord is good to those who wait on him. Lamentations chapter 3 verse 25. You have been waiting. Waiting for recognition. Waiting for promotion. Waiting for your boss to see what you bring to the table. And the wait has been brutal. But God is good to those who wait. And the goodness he's about to release is going to make the wait worth it. You are good. You are good. It all you do is good. You good. Good. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Let worship settle. Let the atmosphere solidify like cement hardening around a foundation. Because the teaching I am about to bring is the foundation upon which the prayer of workplace favor will be built. Sit, but sit at attention. Every word that comes next is a prophetic key. Go with me to Proverbs chapter 21 verse 1. This is one of the most powerful verses in the entire Bible regarding favor with authority figures. The Bible says the king's heart is in the hand of the Lord as the rivers of water. He turneth it whithersoever he will. The king's heart In Bible times, the king was the ultimate authority, the CEO of the nation, the boss of every boss, the final decision maker. And the Bible says that the heart of this ultimate authority is in God's hand, not in his own hand, not in his wife's hand, not in his advisor's hand, in God's hand. And what does God do with it? He turns it wherever he wills, like rivers of water. Have you ever tried to stop a river? You cannot. It goes where it goes. It flows where it flows. And when God decides to turn a heart, that heart flows in the direction God wants with the same unstoppable force as a river. Now apply this to your situation. Your boss's heart is in God's hand. Your supervisor's attitude is under God's control. Your manager's perception of you is subject to God's manipulation. And when I say manipulation, I do not mean it in a negative sense. I mean that God has the sovereign right and the supernatural ability to adjust how your boss thinks about you, feels about you, and acts toward you. He can turn hostility into hospitality. He can turn blindness into recognition. He can turn criticism into commendation. He can turn neglect into promotion. And that is what we are asking him to do today. We are not asking him to destroy your boss. We are not asking him to punish your supervisor. We are not asking him to curse your manager. We are asking him to turn their heart, to redirect their attitude, to adjust their perception, to recalibrate their opinion of you. When God turns a heart, the person does not even know what happened. They just suddenly feel different about you, they cannot explain it, they did not plan it, they just woke up today and something shifted. They see you differently, they value you differently, they treat you differently. [music] And the explanation is not therapy, the explanation is prayer. Now, go with me to a second scripture, Genesis chapter 39 verses 2 to 4. And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man, and he was in the house of his master, the Egyptian. And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand. And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him, and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand. I want you to see four elements in this passage. First, the Lord was with Joseph. Before favor came, presence came. Before the boss noticed him, God was with him. Your favor does not start with your boss, it starts with your God. If God is with you, favor is inevitable. If God is on your side, promotion is a matter of time. You do not need to charm your boss, you do not need to manipulate your boss, you do not need to flatter your boss, you just need G O D to be with you. And his presence on your life will do what no office politics can accomplish. Second, Joseph was prosperous. The word prosperous here does not mean wealthy, it means everything he touched worked. His projects succeeded, his assignments were completed excellently. His tasks produced results. When God is with you, your work changes. Your output changes. Your quality changes. You begin to operate at a level that is beyond your natural ability because a supernatural dimension has been added to your professional capacity. Third, his master sallallahu wasallam, Potiphar saw that the Lord was with Joseph. The boss noticed. Not because Joseph was self-promoting. Not because Joseph was boasting. The boss noticed because the results were undeniable. When God's favor is on your work, your boss cannot help but notice. The evidence speaks for itself. The numbers tell the story. The quality shouts your name. You do not need to advertise yourself when God is advertising you through your output. Fourth, Joseph found grace in his sight. Grace, unmerited favor. Favor he did not earn. Favor he did not deserve. Favor that defied his status as a slave, a foreigner, a prisoner's son. Grace does not care about your resume. Grace does not care about your background. Grace does not care about your pedigree. Grace looks at you and says, "I choose you. Not because of who you are, but because of who God is." And I prophesy, [music] the same grace that Joseph found in Potiphar's house, you will find in your workplace. Today, not next month. Today. When you walk into that office, into that factory, into that shop, into that school, into that hospital, the grace of God will walk in with you. And your boss will see it. They may not understand it. They may not be able to name it, but they will feel it. Something about you will be different today. Something about your aura will be changed. Something about your energy will be elevated and your boss will respond to it. They will respond with favor, with recognition, with opportunity, with promotion. One more scripture, Psalm 75 verses 6 to 7. For promotion cometh neither from the east nor from the west nor from the south, but God is the judge. He puteth down one and setteth up another. Promotion does not come from your boss, it comes from God. Your boss is the instrument, but God is the author. Your supervisor is the channel, but God is the source. So, when we pray today, we're not praying to your boss. We're praying to the God who controls your boss. We're going to the throne and requesting a heart adjustment. >> [music] >> And when the king on the throne gives the order, the boss in the office has no choice but to comply. Somebody shout, "My boss will favor me today." Say it again with workplace authority, "My boss will favor me today." Hallelujah. Now, stand. It is time to pray. >> [music] >> And this is not a polite prayer. This is an authoritative, kingdom-backed, heaven-endorsed, throne-room-approved prayer that is about to restructure the dynamics of your workplace. Let us pray. >> [music] >> Father, in the powerful name of Jesus Christ, the name before which Pharaoh's heart was turned, the name before which Nebuchadnezzar's mind was humbled, the name before which Cyrus' decree was issued, the name that commands kings and commissions kingdoms, in that name we come before you this morning with a very specific request. We are asking you to turn the heart of our boss, just as you turned the heart of the warden toward Joseph in prison, just as you turned the heart of Artaxerxes toward Nehemiah for the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls, just as you turned the heart of Ahasuerus toward Esther for the preservation of a nation. Turn the heart of our supervisor, our manager, our director, our CEO, our team lead, whoever holds authority over our professional lives, turn their heart toward us in favor. Proverbs chapter 21:1, "You turn the king's heart like rivers of water." We're standing on that word right now. We're not asking for something extra biblical. We're asking for something that is written, something that is promised, something that is proven by the testimony of Joseph, Nehemiah, Esther, Daniel, and a hundred others who walked in workplace favor because you turned the hearts of their bosses. >> [music] >> Now, open your mouth and decree. I decree the heart of my boss is being turned toward me right now. As I pray this prayer, as these words leave my mouth, as my faith ascends to the throne of God, a signal is being sent from heaven to the heart of my boss. A spiritual impulse, a divine nudge, a supernatural adjustment. And when they see me today, or when they think of me today, something will be different. Their disposition will be softer, their attitude will be kinder, their perception will be more favorable. The coldness is thawing, the hostility is melting, the indifference is evaporating. Favor is taking its place. I decree I am like Joseph in my workplace. The Lord is with me. Everything I touch prospers. My assignments produce results that exceed expectations. My projects are delivered with excellence, my ideas are innovative, my work ethic is impeccable, and my boss sees it. Not because I am performing for applause, but because the anointing of God on my professional life demands recognition. You cannot hide what God has illuminated. You cannot ignore what God has spotlighted. And God is putting a spotlight on me in my workplace today. Torive yakanda. Something is shifting. I can feel the anointing of favor descending like oil, like the oil that was poured on Aaron's head and ran down his beard and down to the skirts of his garments. Psalm 133. The oil of favor is being poured on your head right now and it is flowing down down to your shoulders, down to your chest, down to your hands, down to your feet. You are saturated in favor. And when you walk into work today, the oil on you will change the atmosphere of the office. People will sense it. Your boss will sense it. Something is different. Something has shifted. The employee who walks in today is not the same employee who left yesterday. The anointing has changed you. Now, I want to extend this prayer beyond just your boss because workplace favor includes your colleagues, your clients, your vendors, your subordinate, everyone in your professional ecosystem. >> [music] >> Father, let me find favor with everyone in my workplace today. Not just my boss, everyone. Let the receptionist smile when I walk in. Let the security guard greet me warmly. Let my colleagues collaborate willingly. Let my subordinates respect genuinely. Let my clients respond positively. Let the entire atmosphere of my professional environment be saturated with the fragrance of favor. Everywhere I walk, every room I enter, every meeting I attend, every conversation I participate in, favor. Thick, unmistakable, supernatural favor. Proverbs chapter 3 verses 3 to 4. Let not mercy and truth forsake thee. Bind them about thy neck. Write them upon the table of thine heart. So shall thou find favor and good understanding in the sight of God and man. Favor in the sight of God and man, that is the double portion. Not just vertical favor, horizontal favor. Not just God liking you, people liking you. Not just heaven approving you, earth celebrating you. I decree double portion favor over your life. Heaven approves you and your workplace receives you. God says, "Yes." And your boss confirms it. Now, let me pray for destiny restoration through workplace favor. Because your job is not just a paycheck, it is a platform. It is a position within your larger destiny. >> [music] >> And when favor comes to your workplace, it does not just improve your career, it advances your purpose. When Joseph received favor from Potiphar, it was not just a career promotion, it was a destiny positioning. When Daniel received favor from Nebuchadnezzar, it was not just a workplace advancement, it was a kingdom assignment. When Esther received favor from the king, it was not just a royal promotion, it was a rescue mission. Father, align workplace favor with destiny purpose. The favor that comes to my career today, let it not just increase my salary. Let it position [music] me for my life's assignment. The recognition that my boss gives me today, let it not just stroke my ego. Let it open a door that leads to my divine mandate. Use my workplace as a launch pad for my destiny. Use my boss as an instrument for my promotion into purpose. I decree every dormant gift inside [music] you that your current role has not required is about to be activated. [music] Your boss is going to assign you something new, something different, something that requires the very gift you thought was irrelevant [music] in this season. And that assignment is going to become the bridge between your current position and your ultimate purpose. Do not refuse the assignment. Do not be intimidated by it. Take it because it is not just work. It is destiny knocking on the door of your career. Now, family deliverance because workplace problems often have family roots. Some of you come from families where no one ever receive favor from authority figures. Your father was always overlooked at his job. Your mother was always passed over. Your siblings have the same pattern. It is not coincidence. It is a generational design. But Galatians chapter 3 verse 13, Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. The generational pattern of being unfavored by authority is a curse, [music] and Christ has redeemed you from it. In the name of Jesus, I break every generational curse of workplace disfavor, every pattern of being overlooked that has run in my family broken. Every cycle of being passed over that has plagued my bloodline ended. Every ancestral covenant that programmed my family to be invisible to bosses and authority figures canceled. From today, my family is a favored family. My parents will be favored. My siblings will be favored. My children will grow up walking in unprecedented favor with every authority figure they encounter. The curse is broken. The pattern is dead. A new lineage of favor begins with me. Now, marriage because workplace stress affects marriage. And when your boss does not favor you, the frustration you carry home affects your spouse, your children, your intimacy, your peace. Father, as favor increases in the workplace, let peace increase in the home. Let the smile that comes from being favored at work translate into warmth in the bedroom. Let the confidence that comes from being recognized by the boss translate into security in the marriage. Let the financial increase that comes from favor fuel promotion translate into provision for the family. Workplace favor is household favor. Career breakthrough is family breakthrough. Let it flow from the office into the living room, from the boardroom into the bedroom, from the work space into the home space. For those who are single, I decree that workplace favor will lead to marital connection. Someone in your workplace or someone connected to your workplace is your spouse. And the favor that comes to your career is going to put you in the right meeting at the right time with the right person. Keep your eyes open. Not every colleague is just a colleague. Some are divine appointments disguised as coworkers. Financial breakthrough through workplace favor. This is practical and specific because favor with your boss often translates directly into financial increase. A favored employee gets raises. A favored employee gets bonuses. A favored employee gets promotions with salary increases. A favored employee gets recommended for opportunities that pay more. Psalm 35:27, "Let them shout for joy and be glad that favor my righteous cause. Yea, let them say continually, let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant." God takes pleasure in your prosperity. He enjoys seeing you get the raise. He delights in watching you receive the bonus. He celebrates when your promotion comes with a financial upgrade. This is not worldly ambition. This is divine design. God wants you to prosper in your workplace and favor is the vehicle. Father, I pray let workplace favor produce financial breakthrough. Let the favor on my life cause my boss to approve my raise. Let it cause my supervisor to recommend my promotion. Let it cause my company to increase my compensation. Let it cause clients to prefer me, customers to choose me, partners to select me. Let every financial gate in my career swing open because of the favor of God on my life. I decree someone in this service is about to receive a salary increase that they did not request. Your boss is going to call you into the office or send you a message and say we have decided to adjust your compensation. No performance review prompted it. No negotiation initiated it. The hand of God moved the heart of management to bless you financially. Receive it. Someone else is going to be promoted into a position that was not advertised. A position that was created specifically for you. Your boss is going to say, "I have been thinking about this and I believe you are the right person for a new role we are creating." The role did not exist yesterday, but God created it today for you. Hallelujah. Health and healing because an unhealthy employee cannot receive the full benefit of workplace favor. If you are constantly sick, constantly absent, constantly fatigued, even if your boss wants to promote you, your health becomes a liability. The enemy knows this. That is why he attacks the bodies of people who are on the verge of promotion. He sends sickness at strategic moments. Just when you are about to be noticed, a health crisis pulls you out of the office. Just when your boss is about to recommend you, you are absent for 2 weeks with an unexplained illness. But 3 John chapter 1 verse 2 says, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth." Health and prosperity are connected. Your physical wellness is tied to your professional advancement. God wants you healthy enough to receive the favor, perform in the position, and sustain the promotion. Father, I pray, give them health for the season of favor. Let no sickness interrupt what you are about to do in their careers. Let no disease delay what you are about to accomplish in their workplaces. Heal everybody in this service. Strengthen every immune system. Restore [music] every organ. Repair every cell. I speak to every sickness that has been strategically deployed to prevent workplace breakthrough. Chronic fatigue designed to reduce performance, leave now. Migraines that always strike before important presentations, your assignment is terminated. Back pain that keeps you from your desk, be healed now. Anxiety that paralyzes you in meetings, be broken now. Depression that drains your productivity, lift now. Every health condition that has been weaponized against your career is being neutralized by the healing power of the Holy Ghost. Isaiah chapter 40 verse 29, "He giveth power to the faint, and to them that have no might, he increaseth strength." Power to the faint, strength to the weak, energy to the depleted. You are being recharged, not just spiritually, physically. When you walk into work today, your body will cooperate with the favor on your life. You will be sharp, you will be alert, you will be energetic, you will be present, fully, completely, vibrantly present. Now, the deep work. Covenants, curses, and altars that specifically target your favor with authority figures. Some of you have wondered, why does every boss I have ever had eventually turn against me? Why does every supervisor start out liking me and then gradually become hostile? Why does every authority figure in my life, not just bosses, but teachers, pastors, mentors, why do they all eventually reject me? If this pattern is consistent across multiple workplaces, multiple relationships, and multiple authority figures, the problem is not them. The problem is spiritual. There is an active spiritual mechanism that is poisoning your relationships with authority figures. It could be a covenant, it could be a curse, it could be an altar. Here is how it works. In some cultures, when children are born, they are dedicated, knowingly or unknowingly, to deities or spirits. This dedication sometimes come with conditions. One common condition is this child will never serve under earthly authority without conflict. The spirit ensures that the person is constantly at odds with bosses, supervisors, leaders, and anyone in authority over them. It is not personality clash, it is demonic interference. Or perhaps someone spoke a curse over you. You will never find a boss who appreciates you. You will always be the scapegoat at work. No matter where you go, your superiors will hate you." Those words, if spoken with spiritual authority whether by a bitter parent, an envious relative, or a wicked colleague can create a magnetic field that repels favor with authority figures. But today, we dismantle the mechanism. We destroy the machinery. We demolish the infrastructure. Galatians chapter 3 verse 13, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us." In the name of Jesus, I cancel every covenant that has programmed my life for conflict with authority figures. Every dedication that was performed when I was a child that gave a spirit the right to sabotage my relationships with bosses, I renounce it. I did not consent to it. I was an infant. I was ignorant. But today, as an adult with the knowledge of Christ and the power of his blood, I revoke every agreement made on my behalf. My relationship with authority is no longer governed by demonic covenant. It is governed by the kingdom principle of favor. I break every curse that has been spoken to ensure I never experience favor with a boss. Every word that said you will always be hated at work, broken by the blood. Every declaration that said no superior will ever appreciate you, canceled by the cross. Every prophecy of workplace rejection, reversed by the power of the resurrection. I speak to every altar that has been receiving sacrifices to poison my workplace relationships. Altars where my name has been mentioned in connection with office failure. Altars where rituals have been performed to make my boss turn against me. Altars where enchantments have been spoken to create a wall of hostility between me and my supervisors. I command those altars to catch fire right now. Burn with the fire that consumed Elijah's sacrifice. Burn with the fire that fell at Pentecost. Burn until nothing remains. Not a stone, not an ash, not a memory. >> [music] >> I decree the siege is over. The workplace siege, the career siege, the professional siege. That grinding, demoralizing season of being unfavored, unrecognized, and unappreciated by your boss, it is finished. A new season of favor is dawning. And when it breaks like the morning sun, the [clears throat] darkness of disfavor will flee like shadows at sunrise. I decree, walk into favor when you walk into work today. Do not walk in with your head down. Do not walk in with fear in your chest. Do not walk in expecting the worst. Walk in with favor on your forehead. Walk in with anointing on your shoulders. Walk in with confidence in your step. Walk in knowing that the God who turned the king's heart like rivers of water has already turned your bosses' hearts toward you. It is done. I decree your destiny is preserved and your career is accelerating. The stagnation is over. The slow-motion years are behind you. From today, your career moves at the speed [music] of grace. Promotions that should take years will happen in months. Recognitions that should take months will happen in weeks. Salary increases that should take quarters will happen in days. You are in the fast lane of divine favor and there is no traffic on God's highway. I decree this week is your testimony week. Before Friday, before Friday, something will happen in your workplace that will serve as unmistakable evidence that God answered this prayer. A word from your boss, a look from your supervisor, an email from HR, a meeting invitation that surprises you, something. And when it happens, you will know. You will keenly know in the deepest chamber of your spirit that the God of Joseph, the God of Daniel, the God of Esther, the God of Nehemiah is your God and he has favored you. I decree your family is blessed through your workplace favor. Your promotion will fund your children's education. Your salary increase will pay off your family's debts. Your recognition will open doors for your siblings. Your career advancement will honor your parents in their old age. The favor on your professional life is a family blessing. It overflows from the office into the household. I decree every enemy in your workplace is neutralized. Every jealous colleague, every manipulative supervisor, every backstabbing coworker, every scheming competitor, they are under the authority of the God who controls hearts. And the same God who can turn the heart of a king toward you can turn the heart of an enemy away from their wicked plans. Their plots will fail. Their schemes will collapse. Their whispers will be silenced and you will stand untouched, untarnished, and unstoppable in the full glory of God's workplace favor. Yash kelavontundai, toriveyakandai, mekoroshpreshelundai, sekuribamashkai, preshtialorikundai, lorikobavandai, torimikelvashundai. Sekori Bayakundae, Mekorosh Valtundae, Yash Kela Preshundae, Preshtia Lorishundae, Tori Bashkai, Sekori Bashkai, Tori Veyakandai, Mekorosh Preshi Lundae, Yash Kela Vontundae, Preshtia Lorikundae, Lori Kobandae, Tori Mekel Vasundae. It is sealed. It is done. It is finished. The prayer has landed. The decree has been registered. The prophecy has been recorded and the favor has been activated. Now, praise praise like you already got the promotion. Praise like you already received the raise. Praise like your boss already called you into the office and said, "I have been thinking about you." Praise like the email has already arrived. Praise in advance because faith calls those things which be not as though they were. Romans chapter 4 verse 17. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, the communion of the Holy Spirit go with you to your workplace today, sit with you in your meetings, stand with you before your boss, speak through you in your presentations, shine through you in your output, favor you in every interaction, promote you in every evaluation, protect you in every conflict, prosper you in every assignment. >> [music] >> You are going to work today as a favored employee. Not by human effort, by divine arrangement, not by office politics, by heaven's politics, not by your charm, by God's anointing. Now go. Go to work. Go with fire. Go with favor. Go with the boldness of Daniel. Go with the excellence of Joseph. Go with the wisdom of Esther. Go with the anointing of the Holy Ghost. And watch what happens when a prayed up anointed favored child of God walks into a workplace.
